fusions.name: Leashed Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a tethered javelin at an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. Anything it strikes moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Paid-Out Sweep
fusions.desc: Swings a tethered head in a full circle that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and stuns each one for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Short Tether
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snapback
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, a bolt leaps along the tether to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, where it deals 8 damage and slows it by 20% for 3 seconds. Once every 4 seconds.
